method.model_outputs: Reused archived sampled generations and the original extract_sql method.
method.validation: SQLite EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN with the existing read-only query authorizer.
method.baseline_verified: All 10 gold error strings and all 576 saved model validity flags reproduced.

compatibility_rules.scope: Apply the same rules to gold and model SQL across all 192 rows, without consulting the gold answer when repairing a model query.
compatibility_rules.schema: For schema build failures due to duplicate definitions, merge simple, unconstrained CREATE TABLE declarations by case-insensitive table name. Retain the first spelling of each column and coalesce duplicates only when their declared types agree.
compatibility_rules.offset: After SQLite rejects OFFSET, add LIMIT -1 before a single trailing top-level OFFSET followed by a nonnegative integer, when no top-level LIMIT exists.
compatibility_rules.alias: After SQLite rejects a dollar-prefixed alias token, quote that token when explicitly introduced by AS in a SELECT.

method.limitation: Schema union assumes repeated declarations describe the same logical table. Compilation measures SQLite acceptance only.
